source.title: TNoodle 0.13.2
source.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.2 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
The following changes have been made since TNoodle 0.12.0:

 - TNoodle now supports connecting to the WCA website to retrieve the events and rounds of a competition.
 - FMC sheets are now available in 22 languages. The full list is available here: https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/tree/v0.13.2/webscrambles/src/i18n.

This new release fixes a bug occurring in specific browsers with TNoodle 0.13.1, where the generated zip file would miss its extension.
Both TNoodle 0.13.2 and TNoodle 0.13.1 are current versions of the scramble program, and either can be used to generate scrambles for a competition.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

translation.title: TNoodle 0.13.2 发布
translation.content:
现在可从 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ 下载 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.2。

相较 TNoodle 0.12.0，本次更新包括：

- TNoodle 现可连接 WCA 网站，读取比赛的项目和轮次。
- 最少步答题纸现有 22 种语言版本，完整列表见：https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/tree/v0.13.2/webscrambles/src/i18n.

本次版本修复了 TNoodle 0.13.1 在特定浏览器中的一个问题：生成的 ZIP 文件缺少扩展名。
TNoodle 0.13.2 和 TNoodle 0.13.1 都是当前有效的打乱程序版本，均可用于生成比赛打乱。

请记住，官方比赛必须使用官方打乱程序的当前有效版本，下载地址始终为：
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
